verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax advisory firm offering legal services such as transactions, funds, notary work and a software-supported transparency-register filing unit. It is not a software platform or developer product, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is outside its category. The 404 results for the OpenAPI and llms.txt probes are consistent with this, and nothing in the evidence shows YPOG exposes a public API.
